title: Scalar extension along an isomorphism of ring sheaves
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $R,S$ be sheaves of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$, and let $c:R\xrightarrow{\sim}S$ be an isomorphism of ring sheaves. For every sheaf $M$ of $R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], write $M^{(c)}$ for the same underlying abelian sheaf with $S(U)$-action $s\cdot m=c_U^{-1}(s)m$ on each object $U$. This defines a functor on module sheaves, acting as the original map on each underlying abelian sheaf. There is an isomorphism of $S$-module sheaves, natural in $M$,
$$\theta_{c,M}:M\otimes_R S\xrightarrow{\sim}M^{(c)},$$
where the tensor product is the sheafification of the sectionwise tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. If $\eta_U:M(U)\otimes_{R(U)}S(U)\to(M\otimes_R S)(U)$ is its sheafification unit [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], then $\theta_{c,M,U}(\eta_U(m\otimes s))=c_U^{-1}(s)m$. Its inverse sends $m\in M(U)$ to $\eta_U(m\otimes1)$.
